title: Baba baba kehte
body:
Baba baba kehte
<<MINI>>
SO GAYEE SAKINA
SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<DIVIDER>>
KAISE RABABE KHASTA JIGAR SE KAHE KOI
DUNIYA ME AB TUMHARI SAKINA NAHI RAHI
ASHQON SE APNE BABA KE RUKSAAR DHO GAYEE
AAGOSH ME HUSSAIN KA SAR RAKH KE SO GAYEE
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ZINDA ME KAISE ALLAH JAANE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA ..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
AHLE HARAM ME SHORE BUQA HAI KAISI QAYAMAT AAYI
GURBAT ME PHIR APNI BAHEN KO ROTA HAI EK BHAI
APNA HI NAUHA PADHTE PADHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
GOADI ME RAKHKAR SARVAR KE SAR KO RORO KE DUKHDA SUNAYA
KHAAYE HAI KITNE PATTHAR BATAKAR KURTE KA DAAMAN DIKHAYA
BABA KE MOO PE MOO RAKHE RAKHE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
DIL KO YAQEE THA ZINDA SE EK DIN MIL JAYEGI REHAAI
KOI KABHI TO AAYEGA LENE KAB TAK RAHEGI JUDAAI
ZINDA KE DAR PE BAITHE BAITHE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
GHASSAALA YE DEKH KE  ROYEE KAISE BHALA NAHLAE
KAISE BADAN SE KURTA UTAARE KAISE BHALA KAFNAE
ZAKHMO KI CHADAR ODHE ODHE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
QAIDE SITAM ME PYARI BAHEN KI KIS DIL SE TURBAT BANAYEE
HAATHON SE APNE NA JAANE KAISE NANHI SEE MAYYAT UTHAAYEE
KAISE KIYA TURBAT KE HAVAALE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ROTA RAHA EK BHAI BAHEN KI MAYYAT PAR ZINDA ME
KAHTA RAHA MAAJAEE LAGEGA TUJHKO DAR ZINDA ME
TUJHKO KAHA NEEND AATI THI KAISE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
KAISE RABABE KHASTA JIGAR KO  SAMJHAEGI ZAINAB
BETI KA CHEHRA MAA KO  KAISE DIKHLAEGI ZAINAB
KAISE KAHEGI ROTE ROTE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
KAISE JAGAYE KAISE UTHAYE KAISE LAGAYE DIL SE
AAKHIR YE SADMA KOI BATAYE KAISE UTHAYE DIL SE
BEEMAR KHUD KO KAISE SAMBHAALE SO GAYEE SAKINA
<<MINI>>
BABA BABA KAHTE KAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
ASIF AAMIR KAISE SUNAAYE MAZLOOMA KA NAUHA
AHLE HARAM KO KIS TARHA DE MASOOMA KA PURSA
ZULME SITAMGAR SAHTE SAHTE SO GAYEE SAKINA
